name: adminLockoutThresholdCount
definition: The number of failed administrator logins before lockout (Device > Setup > Management > Authentication Settings). When lockout is off (0) the key is Not evaluated, so a threshold requirement can never pass on it.
population: the global administrator lockout setting of the one firewall the credential reaches
evidenceRequiredForTrue: The management authentication settings showing a failed-attempts value from 1 to 10; lockout off (0) is Not evaluated.
citations: PAN-OS 11.1 XML API and configure CLI command hierarchy (docs.paloaltonetworks.com/pan-os/11-1/pan-os-panorama-api)

changeLog.change: Registered with its first implementation (synthetic-fixture tests only; no real device body replayed yet, so V0).

notes: Lockout off (0) is reported as null (Not evaluated), never 0, so a lessThan or lessThanOrEqual requirement can never pass on a firewall with lockout off. deviceconfig/setting/management/admin-lockout/failed-attempts (0 to 10) from the CLI hierarchy; 0 means lockout is off. Off has no threshold, so it is reported as null (never 0, which would pass a less-than-or-equal requirement) with the reason in the fail reasons. Per-authentication-profile lockout settings are not read; an absent setting is Not evaluated, not 0, because the default is not evidenced.
